text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: It's decided, Alv-senpai!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Duramente's voice as she rushed in was unusually elated.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: This coming Sunday, Tokyo Race 5!

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Yes—it's finally time for the Make Debut.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
—Yes. I'll give it everything
that I was taught.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
"Knowing you,
I'm not worr—"

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: (Is everything really... going to be alright, I wonder...)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: (I can't settle down... I'm more worried about them than myself...)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
(If it's about myself, I can manage on my own.
But because there's nothing I can do...)
choice_data_list: It's all right. Let's believe in our beloved pupil.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: With affection...?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
"...Right.
I'll be there in person on the day."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: I look forward to working with you. Sensei will surely be delighted to see you again after so long.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Duramente's debut was a monumental event even for the academy itself.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: (I suppose I should... prepare for the day of the race.)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: (What I need is... binoculars, and then compress patches... Fever reducer just in case...)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Should I prepare lunch as well...?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
(...Calm yourself.
What are you getting so carried away for?)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: (This is a match. You need to be more serious——)

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
You look like you're in high spirits, Groove-san.
Are you off on a pilgrimage?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
A pilgrimage... Well, not quite.
Though I suppose I must approach it
with a devotion just as sacred.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: (Calm my heart—and watch over it. This precious debut.)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: (And together with that girl, I'll be in the Twinkle Series...!?)

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Groove... -san...?
Groove-san!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: This is bad! Contact the dorm head right away!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hearing the news that Admire Groove
was taken to the hospital, I rushed over in a panic!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Apparently she collapsed out of the blue,
but the exact circumstances and symptoms are unknown.
Heading over to the doctor—

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
Uhm, as for the results...
there was nothing abnormal found anywhere.

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
I checked the CT scan too, and she's in perfect health.
It might have just been a temporary lack of oxygen.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
I see...
...Pardon the disturbance.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...I am sorry for causing you trouble.
choice_data_list: Don't worry about it. So, what's up?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: I was getting ready to watch Duramente-san's debut race. But then—

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Overcome by a strange sensation...

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
This abnormal heaviness in my body...
and this sluggish feeling...

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Before I knew it, I couldn't move a single muscle. There was a kind of mist surrounding me...

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
It might have just been a hallucination
from the lack of oxygen, but...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I think to myself. Admire Groove is an Umamusume with very stable physical condition and autonomic nervous system.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She isn't an Umamusume to collapse over just anything.
Assuming it's not poor physical health—

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: A curse... it might be.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Yes. It's some sort of curse. Perhaps
the sharp fangs of karma have somehow...

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: What... are you talking about?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: A curse... That's so unrealistic...

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: (Tomorrow is finally Duramente-san's debut...)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: (I'll go watch, definitely. Don't worry, something like that is only temporary...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Thump!)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Uh... This... feeling...

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: (No way... It only happens when I think about being there for her debut...)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: A curse...? No way...

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: (That's impossible, no way. But even if, by some million-to-one chance, it were...)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: I won't give in—never.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Admire Groove and Duramente are... "FOBN".

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
They couldn't intersect.
Not in the Origin...

How could this happen...
Just when things were really getting started...

If only she had stayed healthy and well...
What a shame...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"Deorbit"... is impossible...
That is "XACF".

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Still, if we can do a "gravity assist"—

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Only when someone reaches out
a hand to the "ABSS"――
